title: Keep board-only pushes from canceling product CI verification
description: Observed frequent required Kanbus board commits cancel active product CI because every develop push shares cancel-in-progress concurrency. Purpose preserve actual product verification and reduce wasted runs. Allowed .github/workflows/ci.yml and analysis/tests/test_semantic_ci.py only. Push trigger keeps develop/main branches and adds paths-ignore exactly project/issues/** and project/events/**; all product or mixed changes still trigger. Pull-request and manual triggers unchanged; existing jobs/concurrency unchanged. No skip-ci commit messages or disabling tests, no releaseworkflow changes. Gherkin Given product verification running When board-only commit pushed Then no replacement CI run is triggered; Given any product change or mixed board/product push Then ordinary CI runs. RED regression YAML asserts exact narrow ignoredpaths/preservedbranches PRmanual/concurrency; GREEN same plus existing registrytest. Root implements small workflow change, runs isolatedCItests, reviews/pushes single scopedcommit beforeclosure. No reading or editing boardJSON, only Kanbus.
right_now_summary: The team is preparing a narrow CI workflow change to ignore board-only pushes.
